entities.name: Ernst Anschütz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ernst Gebhard Salomon Anschütz was a German teacher, organist, poet, and composer. He is also known for his account of the death of Johann Christian Woyzeck in 1824. Anschütz worked as a teacher in Leipzig for 50 years.

entities.summary: Ernst Gebhard Salomon Anschütz was a German teacher, organist, poet, and composer. He is also known for his account of the death of Johann Christian Woyzeck in 1824. Anschütz worked as a teacher in Leipzig for 50 years.
